gates.evidence: Chats Home is a general chat interface, and the proposal limits offers to non-paying users in SFW contexts.
The reward is for playing a 15-second sponsored game, not for clicks, installs, or ratings.
The proposal uses positive gain framing ('+3 bonus AI Usage Quota actions').
The storyboard shows a clear opt-in flow with 'Play to unlock' and 'Not today' options.
The offer clearly states '+3 bonus AI Usage Quota actions' and '15-second sponsored game' before opt-in.
The user has a clear 'Not today' option that returns them to the Chats Home without penalty.
The offer triggers on Chats Home (s01), not during chat or generation.
The eligibility clause explicitly states: 'never shown to subscribers'.

scores.evidence: The offer triggers on the home screen for a quota refill, providing a direct solution to usage limits.
The ad is additive and non-interruptive, appearing as a sponsored chip on the home screen.
The reward is capped at one per day and limited to non-payers, ensuring the Luzia+ subscription remains the premium choice.
The requested 3 actions (COGS $0.0054) represent roughly 60-80% of net revenue per view ($0.0067-$0.009), exceeding the 30% COGS target.
Chats Home is the core hub of the app (m16), ensuring high visibility.
Uses standard SIM-RWD units on an existing surface (s01).
Refers to r3 (AI Usage Quota), Luzia persona, Chats Home, and the Luzia+ subscription model.
Daily cap of 1 and explicit cooldowns prevent nagging.
Includes a 4-week holdout and clear guardrails for conversion.

requiredChanges: Reduce the reward amount to +1 AI Usage Quota action to ensure the cost-to-serve remains below 30% of the net revenue per view.
Explicitly document the non-inferiority conversion guardrail in the rollout plan.
parsed.topConcern: The COGS for a 3-action reward ($0.0054) significantly exceeds the 30% target relative to the computed net revenue per view, risking the unit economics of the ad placement.
